name: Build Daytona Snapshot

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      commit_sha:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: "The name of the built Daytona snapshot"
        value: ${{ jobs.build-snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build-snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.set-output.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate Commit SHA
        env:
          INPUT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          SHA="$INPUT_SHA"
          if [[ ! "$SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF must be a 40-char commit SHA. Got: $SHA"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set Snapshot Name
        id: set-name
        env:
          INPUT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          SNAPSHOT_NAME="iterate-sandbox-$INPUT_SHA"
          echo "snapshot_name=$SNAPSHOT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Building snapshot: $SNAPSHOT_NAME"

      - name: Build and Push Snapshot
        env:
          INPUT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          # Assuming a script exists to build the snapshot based on the repo state
          # This script should handle idempotency (check if exists before building)
          export DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME="iterate-sandbox-$INPUT_SHA"
          export SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF="$INPUT_SHA"
          
          # Placeholder for actual build command
          # e.g., npm run build:snapshot or ./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh
          if [ -f "./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh" ]; then
            chmod +x ./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh
            ./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh
          else
            echo "No build script found. Ensure ./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh exists or update this step."
            echo "Snapshot name set to: $DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME"
          fi

      - name: Set Output
        id: set-output
        env:
          INPUT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          echo "snapshot_name=iterate-sandbox-$INPUT_SHA" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
